operational-example.copy: Use Biometric Prompt as a bounded component: Request one biometric authentication confirmation with fallback copy without owning the complete auth, enrollment, recovery, or risk process.

rationale: Request one biometric authentication confirmation with fallback copy without owning the complete auth, enrollment, recovery, or risk process.
Auth orchestration, enrollment, recovery, risk scoring, and step-up policies belong to authentication patterns.

items.rule: Owns the visible Biometric Prompt container and spacing.

variants.copy: Biometric Prompt variants define local presentation only. Auth orchestration, enrollment, recovery, risk scoring, and step-up policies belong to authentication patterns.

states.copy: Biometric Prompt states follow explicit precedence so status remains readable and auditable.

variant-state-behavior.copy: Variant controls presentation; state controls local behavior. Auth orchestration, enrollment, recovery, risk scoring, and step-up policies belong to authentication patterns.

full-width.copy: Biometric Prompt may fill its parent when content remains readable and behavior stays local.

responsive-layout-patterns.copy: Use responsive density to preserve labels, state, and targets; do not add pattern orchestration to Biometric Prompt.

viewport-organization.copy: Viewport rules decide density and placement while Biometric Prompt remains a component.
